## Confirmed pre-existing defect this change fixes

Every production lane built `GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme=cfg.gravity_wave_drag)` from
the scheme STRING alone — MPAS (`packages/coupler/legoesm/driver/model_driver.py:6067`),
spectral (`:7578`), and the FV pipeline `_resolve_gwd`
(`packages/coupler/legoesm/driver/physics_pipeline.py:3439`). So the tuned
`ExperimentConfig` scalars `mcfarlane_k_wave` / `mcfarlane_directional_spread` /
`mcfarlane_tau_max` were SILENTLY INERT on every AMIP path, and Hines had no knob at all.
Same gap class as the `convection_config_for` bug fixed earlier this campaign.

Campaign motivation: the ua800 extratropical westerly bias traces to non-orographic drag
(controlled single-delta arm, day-30 matched: hines OFF gives SH +1.61 -> +2.55,
NH +2.08 -> +2.71 m/s at 800 hPa), so the Hines launch amplitude must be tunable.

## The change (uncommitted, `git diff`)

### 1. NEW resolver `physics_pipeline.py:3385-3435`

```python
def gwd_config_for(config):
    """... (docstring omitted, read the file) ..."""
    from legoesm.atmosphere.physics.gravity_wave_drag.config import (
        GravityWaveDragConfig,
    )

    scheme = getattr(config, "gravity_wave_drag", "none")
    override = getattr(config, "gravity_wave_drag_override", None)
    if override is not None:
        return override
    gc = GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme=scheme)
    if scheme == "none":
        return gc
    # McFarlane (orographic) tunables. ``mcfarlane_N_ref`` is deliberately
    # NOT wired: no McFarlaneConfig field of that name exists (dangling
    # ExperimentConfig scalar, tracked separately).
    mc = gc.mcfarlane._replace(
        k_wave=float(getattr(config, "mcfarlane_k_wave", gc.mcfarlane.k_wave)),
        directional_spread=float(getattr(
            config, "mcfarlane_directional_spread",
            gc.mcfarlane.directional_spread)),
        tau_max=float(getattr(config, "mcfarlane_tau_max",
                              gc.mcfarlane.tau_max)),
    )
    # Hines (non-orographic) launch amplitude + saturation flux cap.
    hn = gc.hines._replace(
        total_rms_wind=float(getattr(config, "hines_total_rms_wind",
                                     gc.hines.total_rms_wind)),
        Fmax=float(getattr(config, "hines_Fmax", gc.hines.Fmax)),
    )
    return gc._replace(mcfarlane=mc, hines=hn)
```

`_resolve_gwd` now delegates: `get_gwd_fn(gwd_config_for(config))`; its inline
override branch was removed.

   103	
   104	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   105	# Composite (multi-source) GWD — issue #834
   106	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   107	#
   108	# Orographic (lindzen/mcfarlane) and non-orographic (rayleigh/hines/
   109	# prognostic_spectral) drag parameterize DISTINCT gravity-wave populations
   110	# launched by different sources (flow over topography vs convection/fronts),
   111	# so as body forces on the same column their momentum and thermal tendencies
   112	# add linearly.  A ``+``-joined ``gravity_wave_drag`` string composes them.
   113	#
   114	# At most ONE stateful part (``prognostic_spectral``, which carries a
   115	# wave-action spectrum through ``phys_state.gwd_spectrum``) may appear; its
   116	# spectrum threads through ``spectrum_in``/``spectrum_out``.  The stateless
   117	# parts hold no per-step state.  ``e3sm_cam`` / ``ml_emulator`` are NOT
   118	# composable here (they need extra per-column source fields / a network
   119	# module the composite signature does not carry).
   120	_GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATELESS = ("rayleigh", "lindzen", "mcfarlane", "hines")
   121	_GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATEFUL = ("prognostic_spectral",)
   122	_GWD_COMPOSABLE = _GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATELESS + _GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATEFUL
   123	# Orographic parts accept the optional per-column subgrid-topo stddev.
   124	_GWD_OROGRAPHIC_PARTS = ("lindzen", "mcfarlane")
   125	
   126	
   127	def gwd_carries_spectrum(scheme: str) -> bool:
   128	    """True if a GWD scheme string threads a prognostic wave-action spectrum.
   129	
   130	    Accepts a single scheme (``"prognostic_spectral"``) or a ``+``-composite
   131	    (``"mcfarlane+prognostic_spectral"``).  Shared by the driver's
   132	    prognostic-carry plumbing (``physics_pipeline``) and the spectrum seeding
   133	    (``init_physics_state``) so the "does this scheme carry a spectrum?"
   134	    predicate is defined in exactly one place.
   135	    """
   136	    return any(p in _GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATEFUL for p in scheme.split("+"))
   137	
   138	
   139	# Orographic members accept the per-column ``h_topo_col`` launch amplitude
   140	# (subgrid orography stddev). ``e3sm_cam`` shares the orographic launch
   141	# signature; matches the factories' ``scheme_name in (...)`` orographic test.
   142	_GWD_OROGRAPHIC_LAUNCH = _GWD_OROGRAPHIC_PARTS + ("e3sm_cam",)
   143	
   144	
   145	def gwd_scheme_is_orographic(scheme: str) -> bool:
   146	    """True when ``scheme`` (single or ``+``-composite) has an orographic member.
   147	
   148	    Shared predicate for the compiled ``physics_pipeline`` h_topo_col path so
   149	    "does this scheme launch from subgrid orography?" is defined once.
   150	    """
   151	    return any(p in _GWD_OROGRAPHIC_LAUNCH for p in str(scheme).split("+"))
   152	
   153	
   154	def _validate_gwd_composite(scheme: str) -> None:
   155	    """Raise ValueError unless ``scheme`` is a well-formed GWD composite.
   156	
   157	    Factory-level dispatch hardening (independent of
   158	    ``ExperimentConfig.validate_strict``): every part must be composable and at
   159	    most one stateful source (``prognostic_spectral``) may appear (its
   160	    wave-action spectrum is a single carry).  Without this guard the executor
   161	    would fan out to a non-composable backend with the wrong signature
   162	    (``ml_emulator`` needs a network module; ``e3sm_cam`` needs extra source
   163	    fields) — a low-level ``TypeError`` — or run two spectral sources from the
   164	    same ``spectrum_in`` and return only the last ``spectrum_out``, silently
   165	    corrupting the carry.
   166	    """
   167	    parts = scheme.split("+")
   168	    bad = [p for p in parts if p not in _GWD_COMPOSABLE]
   169	    if bad:
   170	        raise ValueError(
   171	            f"Non-composable GWD part(s) {bad} in composite {scheme!r}; "
   172	            f"composable sources are {_GWD_COMPOSABLE} "
   173	            f"(e3sm_cam / ml_emulator are not composable)."
   174	        )
   175	    n_stateful = sum(p in _GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATEFUL for p in parts)
   176	    if n_stateful > 1:
   177	        raise ValueError(
   178	            f"A GWD composite may contain at most one stateful source "
   179	            f"{_GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATEFUL} (its wave-action spectrum is a single "
   180	            f"carry), got {n_stateful} in {scheme!r}."
   181	        )

   183	
   184	def _combined_gwd(
   185	    u, v, T, p_full, p_half, z_full, z_half, rho, lat, dt,
   186	    config, spectrum_in, h_topo_col=None,
   187	):
   188	    """Sum the tendencies of a ``+``-composite GWD scheme (issue #834).
   189	
   190	    ``config`` is the full :class:`GravityWaveDragConfig`; its ``scheme``
   191	    field (e.g. ``"mcfarlane+prognostic_spectral"``) names the parts and its
   192	    sub-configs supply each backend's parameters.  Returns
   193	    ``(GWDOutput, spectrum_out)`` mirroring ``prognostic_spectral_gwd`` so the
   194	    composite is a drop-in for the prognostic call path.  ``spectrum_out`` is
   195	    the advanced spectrum when a ``prognostic_spectral`` part is present, else
   196	    ``spectrum_in`` unchanged (harmless passthrough for a stateless
   197	    composite).
   198	    """
   199	    parts = config.scheme.split("+")
   200	    du = dv = dT = eps = None
   201	    spectrum_out = spectrum_in
   202	    for part in parts:
   203	        # Per-part single-scheme dispatch reuses get_gwd_fn (which raises on an
   204	        # unknown part) → no duplicated scheme→backend table.
   205	        _name, fn, sub_cfg = get_gwd_fn(config._replace(scheme=part))
   206	        if part in _GWD_COMPOSABLE_STATEFUL:
   207	            out, spectrum_out = fn(
   208	                u, v, T, p_full, p_half, z_full, z_half, rho, lat, dt,
   209	                sub_cfg, spectrum_in,
   210	            )
   211	        elif part in _GWD_OROGRAPHIC_PARTS:
   212	            out = fn(
   213	                u, v, T, p_full, p_half, z_full, z_half, rho, lat, dt,
   214	                sub_cfg, h_topo_col=h_topo_col,
   215	            )
   216	        else:
   217	            out = fn(
   218	                u, v, T, p_full, p_half, z_full, z_half, rho, lat, dt,
   219	                sub_cfg,
   220	            )
   221	        du = out.du_dt if du is None else du + out.du_dt
   222	        dv = out.dv_dt if dv is None else dv + out.dv_dt
   223	        dT = out.dT_dt if dT is None else dT + out.dT_dt
   224	        eps = out.eps_gwd if eps is None else eps + out.eps_gwd
   225	    return GWDOutput(du_dt=du, dv_dt=dv, dT_dt=dT, eps_gwd=eps), spectrum_out
   226	
   227	
   228	def _combined_spec_in(config, phys_state, ncol):
   229	    """Read or seed the wave-action spectrum for a spectrum-carrying composite.
   230	
   231	    Mirrors the pure-``prognostic_spectral`` spec-in logic in each factory,
   232	    reading the spectrum sub-config from ``config.prognostic_spectral`` (the
   233	    composite's full config).  Reseeds to ``launch_flux`` when absent or the
   234	    column count changed.
   235	    """
   236	    pcfg = config.prognostic_spectral
   237	    shape = (ncol, pcfg.n_azimuths, pcfg.n_wavenumbers)
   238	    if phys_state is not None:
   239	        spec_in = phys_state.gwd_spectrum
   240	        if spec_in.shape[0] != ncol:
   241	            spec_in = jnp.full(shape, pcfg.launch_flux)
   242	        return spec_in
   243	    return jnp.full(shape, pcfg.launch_flux)

 # Gravity wave drag resolver
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
+def gwd_config_for(config):
+    """The ``GravityWaveDragConfig`` (scheme + tuned per-scheme leaves) to
+    build a gravity-wave-drag kernel from.
+
+    Third member of the resolver family (:func:`turbulence_config_for`,
+    :func:`convection_config_for`): every lane — FV pipeline, MPAS,
+    spectral — previously built ``GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme=...)`` from
+    the scheme STRING alone, so the tuned ExperimentConfig scalars
+    (``mcfarlane_k_wave`` / ``mcfarlane_directional_spread`` /
+    ``mcfarlane_tau_max``, and the Hines launch amplitude) silently never
+    reached the kernel on ANY production AMIP path; only the AIMIP training
+    path consumed them.  Same gap class as the 2026-07-23 convection and
+    hard-sat overrides.
+
+    ``config.gravity_wave_drag_override`` (a full config whose ``scheme``
+    must equal ``config.gravity_wave_drag`` — enforced by
+    ``validate_strict``) still wins verbatim: an explicitly injected config
+    is never second-guessed by the scalar overlay.
+
+    COMPOSITE schemes ("mcfarlane+hines") carry BOTH leaves, so the overlay
+    is applied per-leaf independently of which names appear in the string.
+    Static Python floats — trace-time constants, no retrace.
+    """
+    from legoesm.atmosphere.physics.gravity_wave_drag.config import (
+        GravityWaveDragConfig,
+    )
+
+    scheme = getattr(config, "gravity_wave_drag", "none")
+    override = getattr(config, "gravity_wave_drag_override", None)
+    if override is not None:
+        return override
+    gc = GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme=scheme)
+    if scheme == "none":
+        return gc
+    # McFarlane (orographic) tunables. ``mcfarlane_N_ref`` is deliberately
+    # NOT wired: no McFarlaneConfig field of that name exists (dangling
+    # ExperimentConfig scalar, tracked separately).
+    mc = gc.mcfarlane._replace(
+        k_wave=float(getattr(config, "mcfarlane_k_wave", gc.mcfarlane.k_wave)),
+        directional_spread=float(getattr(
+            config, "mcfarlane_directional_spread",
+            gc.mcfarlane.directional_spread)),
+        tau_max=float(getattr(config, "mcfarlane_tau_max",
+                              gc.mcfarlane.tau_max)),
+    )
+    # Hines (non-orographic) launch amplitude + saturation flux cap.
+    hn = gc.hines._replace(
+        total_rms_wind=float(getattr(config, "hines_total_rms_wind",
+                                     gc.hines.total_rms_wind)),
+        Fmax=float(getattr(config, "hines_Fmax", gc.hines.Fmax)),
+    )
+    return gc._replace(mcfarlane=mc, hines=hn)
+
+
 def _resolve_gwd(config):

   162	# The atmosphere ExperimentConfig FLATTENS a curated set of tunable scheme
   163	# parameters to scalar fields (e.g. ``cloud_q_c_diagnostic`` <-
   164	# CloudConfig.q_c_diagnostic) instead of nesting the scheme ``*Config``
   165	# NamedTuples, so the class-router cannot reach them.  This maps each registry
   166	# qualified name to its ExperimentConfig scalar — but ONLY for parameters the
   167	# physics pipeline ACTUALLY threads from that scalar into the resolved scheme
   168	# config (``build_cloud_config`` for clouds; ``_resolve_convection`` for
   169	# sbm/bechtold).  Many ``<prefix>_<field>`` scalars EXIST on ExperimentConfig
   170	# yet are never read (``_resolve_turbulence``/``_resolve_microphysics``/
   171	# ``_resolve_gwd`` build default configs and patch only a few fields), so a
   172	# name-convention map would silently claim dead overrides.  The membership here
   173	# is machine-verified end-to-end by ``test_atm_scalar_map_is_pipeline_threaded``
   174	# (builds a pipeline per entry, asserts the resolved scheme config carries the

   251	def _route_overrides_by_class(node, by_key: dict, *, applied: set):
   252	    """Recursively splice ``{(module, class_name): {field: value}}`` into a
   253	    config NamedTuple tree (depth-first; child configs updated before parent).
   254	
   255	    Keyed on the FULL ``(defining module, class name)`` — not the bare class
   256	    name — so same-named configs in different components (e.g. the ocean
   257	    vertical-mixing ``TKEConfig`` vs the atmosphere turbulence ``TKEConfig``)
   258	    never cross-route.  Records each applied key in ``applied`` so the caller can
   259	    detect a target config that is ABSENT (never applied) or AMBIGUOUS (two
   260	    instances of the same class in the tree)."""
   261	    fields = getattr(node, "_fields", None)
   262	    if fields is None or not isinstance(node, tuple):
   263	        return node  # not a NamedTuple leaf
   264	    replacements = {}
   265	    for f in fields:
   266	        child = getattr(node, f)
   267	        new_child = _route_overrides_by_class(child, by_key, applied=applied)
   268	        if new_child is not child:
   269	            replacements[f] = new_child
   270	    if replacements:

 succeeded in 1325ms:
20-   *single bulk-amplitude* approximation of the Hines spectrum: one rms
21-   wave amplitude ``sigma`` is propagated and saturated per column rather
22-   than the full azimuthal + vertical-wavenumber spectrum.  Consequently
23-   the whole packet saturates at once and the per-level deposition
24:   ``(sigma_grown^2 - sigma_new^2)·rho`` is large; the ``Fmax`` clip then
25-   *binds* over a substantial fraction of a realistic column (≈22-40 % of
26:   levels on 30-60 level grids at the default ``total_rms_wind``), so the
27-   cap — not the Doppler-spread physics — shapes the drag profile there.
28-   The drag remains a physically-signed momentum sink and is AD-safe
29-   (differentiable a.e.; the ``clip``/``minimum`` limiters are subgradient
30-   kinks, not everywhere-smooth); only its *vertical distribution* is
31-   cap-dominated.  A
32-   faithful upgrade (spectral/azimuthal Hines) plus a QBO / momentum-flux
33:   benchmark is required before retuning ``Fmax`` / ``total_rms_wind`` —
34-   retuning without a benchmark would be guessing.  Default GWD scheme is
35-   ``none``; this scheme is opt-in.
36-
37-Faithfulness to Hines (1997)

66-    loss returned as local frictional heating) are bulk-closure DESIGN choices — Hines deposits
67-    the vector momentum/energy of the dissipating spectrum, which need not be antiparallel to the
68-    local ``U`` and distinguishes wave-energy dissipation from mean-flow KE dissipation and

     1	"""Single-bulk-amplitude WKB gravity wave drag (Hines-1997-inspired).
     2	
     3	.. warning::
     4	
     5	   This is **NOT** the full Hines (1997) Doppler-spread *spectrum*.  It is
     6	   a single-bulk-amplitude WKB approximation: one rms wave amplitude is
     7	   propagated and saturated per column (see the disclosed-simplification
     8	   note below), rather than the full azimuthal + vertical-wavenumber
     9	   Doppler-spread spectrum.
    10	
    11	Non-orographic GWD scheme: a single bulk wave amplitude grows with
    12	decreasing density and is capped by a smooth saturation amplitude. Uses
    13	bottom-up propagation with smooth sigmoid activation for AD-safety —
    14	differentiable ALMOST EVERYWHERE (the ``clip``/``minimum`` drag-floor and
    15	tendency limiters are subgradient KINKS, not everywhere-smooth).
    16	
    17	.. note::
    18	
    19	   **Disclosed simplification / limitation (F-GWD-2, defer).** This is a
    20	   *single bulk-amplitude* approximation of the Hines spectrum: one rms
    21	   wave amplitude ``sigma`` is propagated and saturated per column rather
    22	   than the full azimuthal + vertical-wavenumber spectrum.  Consequently
    23	   the whole packet saturates at once and the per-level deposition
    24	   ``(sigma_grown^2 - sigma_new^2)·rho`` is large; the ``Fmax`` clip then
    25	   *binds* over a substantial fraction of a realistic column (≈22-40 % of
    26	   levels on 30-60 level grids at the default ``total_rms_wind``), so the
    27	   cap — not the Doppler-spread physics — shapes the drag profile there.
    28	   The drag remains a physically-signed momentum sink and is AD-safe
    29	   (differentiable a.e.; the ``clip``/``minimum`` limiters are subgradient
    30	   kinks, not everywhere-smooth); only its *vertical distribution* is
    31	   cap-dominated.  A
    32	   faithful upgrade (spectral/azimuthal Hines) plus a QBO / momentum-flux
    33	   benchmark is required before retuning ``Fmax`` / ``total_rms_wind`` —
    34	   retuning without a benchmark would be guessing.  Default GWD scheme is
    35	   ``none``; this scheme is opt-in.
    36	
    37	Faithfulness to Hines (1997)
    38	----------------------------
    39	This is a Hines-INSPIRED bulk heuristic, NOT a faithful Hines Doppler-spread parameterization.
    40	The Hines (1997) MECHANISM — an incident azimuthal + vertical-wavenumber SPECTRUM whose
    41	Doppler-shifted cutoff vertical wavenumber evolves with the background wind and the wave-induced
    42	rms wind (eq. 9 is that cutoff-wavenumber relation, NOT a velocity-amplitude cap) — is ABSENT.
    43	This scheme propagates ONE bulk rms amplitude and saturates it against a scalar (per-column, but
    44	locally ``N(z)``-dependent) scale ``σ_sat = N(z)/m_*`` — one amplitude, one scale per level.
    45	FAITHFUL to Hines — only the undamped-WKB amplitude scaling:
    46	  * the amplitude grows with ``1/√ρ`` between levels, ``σ_grown = σ·√(ρ[k+1]/ρ[k])`` — the WKB
    47	    scaling for a conserved ``ρσ²`` (NOTE: ``ρσ²`` is the code's ASSUMED invariant, NOT the true
    48	    momentum flux ``ρ⟨u'w'⟩``, which carries the wave-geometry ``k/m`` correlation omitted here).
    49	DEPARTURES from Hines — the mechanism is gone:
    50	  * **NO Doppler-spread SPECTRUM**: a SINGLE bulk rms amplitude, not the azimuthal +
    51	    vertical-wavenumber spectrum whose cutoff evolution IS the Hines mechanism (F-GWD-2);
    52	  * **NO background-wind coupling in propagation**: the wind is NOT used for Doppler shifting,
    53	    cutoff evolution, critical-level filtering, or refraction — it enters ONLY as (a) the
    54	    antiparallel sink DIRECTION and (b) the tendency limiter (``lat`` and ``p_half`` are unused;
    55	    a resting column can still saturate the packet internally, the projection just zeroes the
    56	    RETURNED vector tendency and heating);
    57	  * ``σ_sat = N/m_*`` is a **bulk saturation-amplitude HEURISTIC** (a velocity scale ≈ the
    58	    intrinsic phase speed ``N/m_*``), NOT Hines eq. 9's cutoff wavenumber;
    59	  * the deposition ``drag = ρ(σ²_grown − σ²_new)`` (where ``σ_new`` is the smoothly-saturated
    60	    amplitude ``σ_grown(1−f)+σ_sat·f``, equal to ``σ_sat`` only in the hard-saturation limit
    61	    ``f→1``) is a per-layer STRESS DECREMENT [Pa] (``accel = −decrement/(ρ·dz)``). Under the
    62	    code's ASSUMED fixed wave geometry/proportionality ``F ∝ ρσ²`` this reads as a stress-flux
    63	    divergence, but it is NOT Hines' spectral vector momentum flux — the azimuthal-spectrum vector
    64	    covariance ``ρ⟨u'w'⟩`` (with its ``k/m`` sign/geometry) that Hines deposits is absent here;
    65	  * the **antiparallel "pure deceleration along U" and the KE→heat closure** (all mean-flow KE
    66	    loss returned as local frictional heating) are bulk-closure DESIGN choices — Hines deposits
    67	    the vector momentum/energy of the dissipating spectrum, which need not be antiparallel to the
    68	    local ``U`` and distinguishes wave-energy dissipation from mean-flow KE dissipation and
    69	    heat-flux (Becker & McLandress 2009);
    70	  * the ``Fmax`` cap and the tendency limiter are **UNCLOSED sinks**: the scan removes the FULL
    71	    uncapped amplitude loss from the wave carry but deposits only the CAPPED stress on the mean
    72	    flow, so excess wave momentum/energy is lost rather than transferred — so even in the
    73	    interior the mean-flow drag no longer equals the wave stress-flux divergence (momentum is
    74	    not conserved; energy of the mean flow that IS removed is still heated back exactly).
    75	NUMERICS (AD-safety): the smooth sigmoid saturation (``doppler_sharpness``) — NOTE this smooth
    76	blend is a two-sided relaxation toward ``σ_sat``, so BELOW threshold (``σ_grown < σ_sat``, where
    77	``f_diss`` is small but nonzero) it nudges the carry amplitude slightly UP toward ``σ_sat`` (a weak
    78	spurious SOURCE); the drag clamp ``[0, Fmax]`` floors the resulting negative decrement to 0, so this
    79	sub-threshold gain is neither drag nor heat but an unbudgeted carry perturbation of the AD smoothing
    80	(a hard ``σ_grown > σ_sat`` gate would not have it); the ``accel`` magnitude limiter
    81	(E3SM-PROVENANCE constants ``tndmax``/``umcfac``, a LOOSE analog of E3SM's per-phase-speed
    82	``|c−u|/dt`` limiter — NOT
    83	E3SM-equivalent: no phase speed ``c``, one scalar magnitude, no post-limit stress reconstruction);
    84	density / ``U_mag`` floors; the scan-carry dtype pin.
    85	Non-behavioral pins: ``tests/atmosphere/hydrostatic/unit/test_hines_gwd_faithful.py``.
    86	
    87	References
    88	----------
    89	- Hines, C. O. (1997). Doppler-spread parameterization of gravity-wave
    90	  momentum deposition in the middle atmosphere. 1. Basic formulation.
    91	  J. Atmos. Solar-Terr. Phys., 59, 371-386.
    92	"""
    93	
    94	from __future__ import annotations
    95	
    96	import jax
    97	import jax.numpy as jnp
    98	
    99	from legoesm import constants
   100	from legoesm.atmosphere.physics._shared import brunt_vaisala_n_full
   101	from legoesm.atmosphere.physics.gravity_wave_drag.config import HinesConfig
   102	from legoesm.atmosphere.physics.gravity_wave_drag.output import GWDOutput
   103	
   104	# Machine-checked scheme contract (see tests/test_physics_contracts.py).
   105	__physics_contract__ = {
   106	    "summary": (
   107	        "Hines-INSPIRED non-orographic gravity-wave drag (single bulk-amplitude "
   108	        "heuristic, NOT the Doppler-spread spectrum): a launched rms wave amplitude "
   109	        "grows with 1/sqrt(rho) upward, saturates against a bulk scalar scale "
   110	        "N/m_*, and deposits the per-layer stress decrement as a drag on the flow."
   111	    ),
   112	    "inputs": {
   113	        "u": "m/s", "v": "m/s", "T": "K",
   114	        "p_full": "Pa", "p_half": "Pa", "z_full": "m", "z_half": "m",
   115	        "rho": "kg/m^3", "lat": "rad", "dt": "s",
   116	    },
   117	    "outputs": {
   118	        "du_dt": "m/s^2", "dv_dt": "m/s^2", "dT_dt": "K/s", "eps_gwd": "W/m^2",
   119	    },
   120	    "sign_convention": (
   121	        "z up. Drag opposes the wind: accel is a pure deceleration along the "
   122	        "local wind vector (du_dt*u + dv_dt*v <= 0); stress decrement "
   123	        "drag = rho*(sigma_grown^2 - sigma_new^2) is floored at 0 (a sink). "
   124	        "eps_gwd>=0 is the column KE loss returned as frictional heating "
   125	        "dT_dt = -(u*du_dt + v*dv_dt)/c_pd."
   126	    ),
   127	    # KE->heat is an EXACT local closure: the resolved mean-flow KE removed
   128	    # (-U.a) is returned exactly as frictional heating (c_pd*sum(rho*dT_dt*dz)
   129	    # == eps_gwd). But total WAVE + mean-flow ENERGY is NOT conserved: the
   130	    # launched wave is an EXTERNAL/unbudgeted source, and the Fmax cap + the
   131	    # tendency limiter discard the implied carry loss (the scan removes the
   132	    # full uncapped amplitude loss from the wave but deposits only the capped
   133	    # stress on the mean flow). Momentum is not conserved either. Hence
   134	    # "none" -- the only exact invariant is the resolved-KE->heat closure,
   135	    # pinned by the idealized test, not a total-energy conservation law.
   136	    "conserves": ["none"],
   137	    # True = AD-compatible (a defined VJP everywhere, incl. the clip/minimum
   138	    # subgradient kinks); NOT everywhere-smooth (see NUMERICS in the docstring).
   139	    "differentiable": True,
   140	    "reference": (
   141	        "Hines (1997), J. Atmos. Solar-Terr. Phys. 59, 371-386 "
   142	        "(Doppler-spread parameterization, basic formulation)"
   143	    ),
   144	    "idealized_test": (
   145	        "tests/atmosphere/hydrostatic/unit/test_gravity_wave_drag.py: rest "
   146	        "state -> zero tendency; du_dt*u + dv_dt*v <= 0 at every level; "
   147	        "c_pd*sum(rho*dT_dt*dz) == eps_gwd >= 0 (KE->heat closure)"
   148	    ),
   149	}

   151	
   152	def hines_gwd(
   153	    u: jax.Array,
   154	    v: jax.Array,
   155	    T: jax.Array,
   156	    p_full: jax.Array,
   157	    p_half: jax.Array,
   158	    z_full: jax.Array,
   159	    z_half: jax.Array,
   160	    rho: jax.Array,
   161	    lat: jax.Array,
   162	    dt: float,
   163	    config: HinesConfig,
   164	) -> GWDOutput:
   165	    """Compute Hines-inspired bulk GWD tendencies.
   166	
   167	    Parameters
   168	    ----------
   169	    u, v, T, p_full, p_half, z_full, z_half, rho, lat, dt, config
   170	        Standard GWD backend signature. All column arrays (ncol, nlev).
   171	
   172	    Returns
   173	    -------
   174	    GWDOutput
   175	    """
   176	    ncol, nlev = u.shape
   177	
   178	    # Brunt-Väisälä frequency at full levels
   179	    N_full = brunt_vaisala_n_full(T, p_full, z_full)
   180	
   181	    # Wind magnitude at each level
   182	    U_mag = jnp.sqrt(u ** 2 + v ** 2 + 1e-10)
   183	
   184	    # Layer thickness
   185	    dz = jnp.abs(z_half[:, :-1] - z_half[:, 1:])
   186	    dz = jnp.clip(dz, 1.0, None)
   187	
   188	    # Saturation amplitude per level:
   189	    # As the bulk wave propagates upward its amplitude grows with decreasing
   190	    # density (the code's assumed WKB invariant rho*sigma^2 = const; this is
   191	    # NOT the true momentum flux rho*<u'w'>).  Saturation occurs when the
   192	    # wave-induced velocity perturbation reaches a BULK saturation-amplitude
   193	    # scale ``sigma_sat = N / m_*`` (a velocity ~ the intrinsic phase speed;
   194	    # a heuristic, NOT Hines 1997 eq. 9's cutoff wavenumber), constant per
   195	    # column at fixed N and m_*.  An earlier formulation divided this
   196	    # by ``rho_ratio = sqrt(rho_sfc/rho) ≥ 1`` ⇒ ``sigma_sat`` *decreased*
   197	    # with altitude, the opposite of physical expectation: amplitudes
   198	    # grow with altitude (1/sqrt(rho)) so the cap should remain at least
   199	    # constant.  The /rho_ratio factor caused premature saturation aloft
   200	    # and biased the drag deposition lower in the column (audit GWD-B2).
   201	    sigma_sat = N_full / jnp.clip(config.m_star, 1e-6, None)
   202	
   203	    # Per-level WKB growth factor for the bottom-up scan.  Going from
   204	    # level (k+1) to level k (one step upward), the amplitude grows by
   205	    # ``sqrt(rho[k+1] / rho[k])`` (energy conservation rho * sigma^2).
   206	    # The carry already contains the integrated WKB amplitude from the
   207	    # surface to level k+1, so we multiply by the *inter-level* ratio,
   208	    # not the cumulative ``sqrt(rho_sfc/rho_k)``.  Multiplying by the
   209	    # cumulative factor at every step compounds the growth and
   210	    # over-amplifies the wave by a product of cumulative ratios — a
   211	    # bug masked in operational use only because the sigma_sat cap
   212	    # truncates the runaway.
   213	    rho_ratio_step = jnp.ones_like(rho)
   214	    rho_ratio_step = rho_ratio_step.at[:, :-1].set(
   215	        jnp.sqrt(jnp.clip(
   216	            rho[:, 1:] / jnp.clip(rho[:, :-1], 0.01, None), 1.0, None,  # coeff-ok: density-ratio floor
   217	        ))
   218	    )
   219	
   220	    # Bottom-up scan: propagate sigma_gw upward from surface.
   221	    # ``rho_ratio_step[:, k]`` carries amplitude from level k+1 to level k;
   222	    # at the surface (k = nlev-1) the step factor is 1 (initial condition).
   223	    def scan_fn(carry, k_rev):
   224	        sigma_gw = carry
   225	        k = nlev - 1 - k_rev
   226	
   227	        # Amplitude growth from density decrease (single-layer step)
   228	        sigma_grown = sigma_gw * rho_ratio_step[:, k]
   229	
   230	        # Smooth blend toward the saturation amplitude. ABOVE threshold
   231	        # (sigma_grown > sigma_sat) this dissipates (sigma_new < sigma_grown,
   232	        # a sink). BELOW threshold the sigmoid is small but NONZERO, so
   233	        # sigma_new = sigma_grown*(1-f)+sigma_sat*f is pulled slightly UP
   234	        # toward sigma_sat (sigma_new > sigma_grown): a weak spurious SOURCE
   235	        # in the carry. The drag floor clip(., 0, Fmax) zeroes the resulting
   236	        # negative decrement, so this sub-threshold amplitude gain is neither
   237	        # drag nor heat -- an unbudgeted carry perturbation of the smooth
   238	        # (AD) sigmoid, not a physical process (see NUMERICS in the docstring).
   239	        f_diss = jax.nn.sigmoid(
   240	            config.doppler_sharpness * (sigma_grown - sigma_sat[:, k])
   241	        )
   242	        sigma_new = sigma_grown * (1.0 - f_diss) + sigma_sat[:, k] * f_diss
   243	
   244	        # Stress decrement: ``ΔF = ρ · (σ²_grown - σ²_new)`` [Pa].  Under the
   245	        # code's ASSUMED fixed wave geometry/proportionality ``F ∝ ρσ²`` this
   246	        # reads as a stress-flux divergence between two levels of the WKB-grown
   247	        # wave; it is NOT the physical spectral flux ``F = ρ·<u'w'>`` — Hines'
   248	        # azimuthal spectrum supplies the vector covariance (the ``k/m`` sign/
   249	        # geometry) that this single-amplitude surrogate lacks.  Acceleration
   250	        # of the mean flow is then ``-ΔF / (ρ·dz)`` [m/s²].
   251	        #
   252	        # An earlier formulation used ``ρ · (σ_grown - σ_new)``, which
   253	        # has units ``kg/(m²·s)`` rather than Pa, so the downstream
   254	        # ``accel = drag / (ρ·dz)`` came out as ``1/s`` rather than
   255	        # ``m/s²`` (audit cycle 2 P1: "Hines drag dimensional
   256	        # inconsistency").  Operationally the two forms gave near-
   257	        # identical drag because Fmax saturates the upper levels in
   258	        # both, but they differ by a factor of ``σ_grown + σ_new``
   259	        # (typically 2-4×) in the sub-saturation troposphere.
   260	        #
   261	        # Clamp the lower bound to zero: the smooth ``f_diss`` sigmoid
   262	        # does not vanish exactly when ``sigma_grown < sigma_sat``, so
   263	        # without the floor a small "anti-drag" leak can appear in the
   264	        # transition region.  GWD on the mean flow is always a sink.
   265	        drag = (sigma_grown ** 2 - sigma_new ** 2) * rho[:, k]
   266	        drag = jnp.clip(drag, 0.0, config.Fmax)
   267	
   268	        # Pin the carry back to the launch-wind precision: under x64 the
   269	        # Python-float ``config.*`` constants promote ``sigma_new`` to f64, but
   270	        # the scan carry init (sigma_gw_init) is ``u.dtype`` (f32) — lax.scan
   271	        # requires carry in/out dtypes to match, so cast the carry output.
   272	        return sigma_new.astype(sigma_gw.dtype), drag
   273	
   274	    # Pin the carry dtype so the scan body stays at the input precision
   275	    # (defaulting allows x64 to silently promote the launch wind to f64).
   276	    sigma_gw_init = jnp.full((ncol,), config.total_rms_wind, dtype=u.dtype)
   277	    _, drag_stack = jax.lax.scan(scan_fn, sigma_gw_init, jnp.arange(nlev))
   278	    drag_all = drag_stack.T[:, ::-1]  # (ncol, nlev), top-first
   279	
   280	    # Convert to acceleration
   281	    accel = -drag_all / jnp.clip(rho * dz, 1e-10, None)
   282	
   283	    # Tendency limiters (E3SM gw_common.F90:642-643).  ``drag_all >= 0`` so
   284	    # ``accel`` is a pure deceleration along the wind; cap its MAGNITUDE
   285	    # without touching its sign.  The fixed ``Fmax`` momentum-flux cap divided
   286	    # by a tiny ``rho*dz`` in thin, low-density upper layers produces
   287	    # physically-implausible accelerations (hundreds of m/s/day); ``tndmax``
   288	    # is the absolute ceiling, and ``umcfac*U_mag/dt`` is a LOCAL no-reversal
   289	    # limiter (Hines is amplitude-based with no explicit phase speed ``c``, so
   290	    # this is the bulk analog of E3SM's ``umcfac*|c-u|/dt``, not the literal
   291	    # phase-speed limiter).  AD-safe (``jnp.minimum``/``jnp.abs`` subgradient
   292	    # ops; no NaN/dead grad).  NOTE: a *post-flux* limiter — where it binds the
   293	    # column drag no longer exactly equals the stress-flux divergence, but
   294	    # stays a momentum SINK (no source).
   295	    tndmax = config.tndmax_per_day / 86400.0
   296	    accel_cap = jnp.minimum(config.umcfac * U_mag / dt, tndmax)
   297	    accel = -jnp.minimum(jnp.abs(accel), accel_cap)
   298	
   299	    cos_a = u / jnp.clip(U_mag, config.U_mag_floor, None)
   300	    sin_a = v / jnp.clip(U_mag, config.U_mag_floor, None)
   301	    du_dt = accel * cos_a
   302	    dv_dt = accel * sin_a
   303	
   304	    # Frictional heating
   305	    dT_dt = -(u * du_dt + v * dv_dt) / constants.c_pd
   306	
   307	    # Column dissipation (positive-definite: KE lost by the mean flow)
   308	    eps_gwd = -jnp.sum(rho * (u * du_dt + v * dv_dt) * dz, axis=1)

   192	    # wave-induced velocity perturbation reaches a BULK saturation-amplitude
   193	    # scale ``sigma_sat = N / m_*`` (a velocity ~ the intrinsic phase speed;
   194	    # a heuristic, NOT Hines 1997 eq. 9's cutoff wavenumber), constant per
   195	    # column at fixed N and m_*.  An earlier formulation divided this
   196	    # by ``rho_ratio = sqrt(rho_sfc/rho) ≥ 1`` ⇒ ``sigma_sat`` *decreased*
   197	    # with altitude, the opposite of physical expectation: amplitudes
   198	    # grow with altitude (1/sqrt(rho)) so the cap should remain at least
   199	    # constant.  The /rho_ratio factor caused premature saturation aloft
   200	    # and biased the drag deposition lower in the column (audit GWD-B2).
   201	    sigma_sat = N_full / jnp.clip(config.m_star, 1e-6, None)
   202	
   203	    # Per-level WKB growth factor for the bottom-up scan.  Going from
   204	    # level (k+1) to level k (one step upward), the amplitude grows by
   205	    # ``sqrt(rho[k+1] / rho[k])`` (energy conservation rho * sigma^2).
   206	    # The carry already contains the integrated WKB amplitude from the
   207	    # surface to level k+1, so we multiply by the *inter-level* ratio,
   208	    # not the cumulative ``sqrt(rho_sfc/rho_k)``.  Multiplying by the
   209	    # cumulative factor at every step compounds the growth and
   210	    # over-amplifies the wave by a product of cumulative ratios — a
   211	    # bug masked in operational use only because the sigma_sat cap
   212	    # truncates the runaway.
   213	    rho_ratio_step = jnp.ones_like(rho)
   214	    rho_ratio_step = rho_ratio_step.at[:, :-1].set(
   215	        jnp.sqrt(jnp.clip(
   216	            rho[:, 1:] / jnp.clip(rho[:, :-1], 0.01, None), 1.0, None,  # coeff-ok: density-ratio floor
   217	        ))
   218	    )
   219	
   220	    # Bottom-up scan: propagate sigma_gw upward from surface.
   221	    # ``rho_ratio_step[:, k]`` carries amplitude from level k+1 to level k;
   222	    # at the surface (k = nlev-1) the step factor is 1 (initial condition).
   223	    def scan_fn(carry, k_rev):
   224	        sigma_gw = carry
   225	        k = nlev - 1 - k_rev
   226	
   227	        # Amplitude growth from density decrease (single-layer step)
   228	        sigma_grown = sigma_gw * rho_ratio_step[:, k]
   229	
   230	        # Smooth blend toward the saturation amplitude. ABOVE threshold
   231	        # (sigma_grown > sigma_sat) this dissipates (sigma_new < sigma_grown,
   232	        # a sink). BELOW threshold the sigmoid is small but NONZERO, so
   233	        # sigma_new = sigma_grown*(1-f)+sigma_sat*f is pulled slightly UP
   234	        # toward sigma_sat (sigma_new > sigma_grown): a weak spurious SOURCE
   235	        # in the carry. The drag floor clip(., 0, Fmax) zeroes the resulting
   236	        # negative decrement, so this sub-threshold amplitude gain is neither
   237	        # drag nor heat -- an unbudgeted carry perturbation of the smooth
   238	        # (AD) sigmoid, not a physical process (see NUMERICS in the docstring).
   239	        f_diss = jax.nn.sigmoid(
   240	            config.doppler_sharpness * (sigma_grown - sigma_sat[:, k])
   241	        )
   242	        sigma_new = sigma_grown * (1.0 - f_diss) + sigma_sat[:, k] * f_diss
   243	
   244	        # Stress decrement: ``ΔF = ρ · (σ²_grown - σ²_new)`` [Pa].  Under the
   245	        # code's ASSUMED fixed wave geometry/proportionality ``F ∝ ρσ²`` this
   246	        # reads as a stress-flux divergence between two levels of the WKB-grown
   247	        # wave; it is NOT the physical spectral flux ``F = ρ·<u'w'>`` — Hines'
   248	        # azimuthal spectrum supplies the vector covariance (the ``k/m`` sign/
   249	        # geometry) that this single-amplitude surrogate lacks.  Acceleration
   250	        # of the mean flow is then ``-ΔF / (ρ·dz)`` [m/s²].
   251	        #
   252	        # An earlier formulation used ``ρ · (σ_grown - σ_new)``, which
   253	        # has units ``kg/(m²·s)`` rather than Pa, so the downstream
   254	        # ``accel = drag / (ρ·dz)`` came out as ``1/s`` rather than
   255	        # ``m/s²`` (audit cycle 2 P1: "Hines drag dimensional
   256	        # inconsistency").  Operationally the two forms gave near-
   257	        # identical drag because Fmax saturates the upper levels in
   258	        # both, but they differ by a factor of ``σ_grown + σ_new``
   259	        # (typically 2-4×) in the sub-saturation troposphere.
   260	        #
   261	        # Clamp the lower bound to zero: the smooth ``f_diss`` sigmoid
   262	        # does not vanish exactly when ``sigma_grown < sigma_sat``, so
   263	        # without the floor a small "anti-drag" leak can appear in the
   264	        # transition region.  GWD on the mean flow is always a sink.
   265	        drag = (sigma_grown ** 2 - sigma_new ** 2) * rho[:, k]
   266	        drag = jnp.clip(drag, 0.0, config.Fmax)
   267	
   268	        # Pin the carry back to the launch-wind precision: under x64 the
   269	        # Python-float ``config.*`` constants promote ``sigma_new`` to f64, but
   270	        # the scan carry init (sigma_gw_init) is ``u.dtype`` (f32) — lax.scan
   271	        # requires carry in/out dtypes to match, so cast the carry output.
   272	        return sigma_new.astype(sigma_gw.dtype), drag
   273	
   274	    # Pin the carry dtype so the scan body stays at the input precision
   275	    # (defaulting allows x64 to silently promote the launch wind to f64).
   276	    sigma_gw_init = jnp.full((ncol,), config.total_rms_wind, dtype=u.dtype)
   277	    _, drag_stack = jax.lax.scan(scan_fn, sigma_gw_init, jnp.arange(nlev))
   278	    drag_all = drag_stack.T[:, ::-1]  # (ncol, nlev), top-first
   279	
   280	    # Convert to acceleration
   281	    accel = -drag_all / jnp.clip(rho * dz, 1e-10, None)
   282	
   283	    # Tendency limiters (E3SM gw_common.F90:642-643).  ``drag_all >= 0`` so
   284	    # ``accel`` is a pure deceleration along the wind; cap its MAGNITUDE
   285	    # without touching its sign.  The fixed ``Fmax`` momentum-flux cap divided
   286	    # by a tiny ``rho*dz`` in thin, low-density upper layers produces
   287	    # physically-implausible accelerations (hundreds of m/s/day); ``tndmax``
   288	    # is the absolute ceiling, and ``umcfac*U_mag/dt`` is a LOCAL no-reversal
   289	    # limiter (Hines is amplitude-based with no explicit phase speed ``c``, so
   290	    # this is the bulk analog of E3SM's ``umcfac*|c-u|/dt``, not the literal
   291	    # phase-speed limiter).  AD-safe (``jnp.minimum``/``jnp.abs`` subgradient
   292	    # ops; no NaN/dead grad).  NOTE: a *post-flux* limiter — where it binds the
   293	    # column drag no longer exactly equals the stress-flux divergence, but
   294	    # stays a momentum SINK (no source).
   295	    tndmax = config.tndmax_per_day / 86400.0
   296	    accel_cap = jnp.minimum(config.umcfac * U_mag / dt, tndmax)
   297	    accel = -jnp.minimum(jnp.abs(accel), accel_cap)
   298	
   299	    cos_a = u / jnp.clip(U_mag, config.U_mag_floor, None)
   300	    sin_a = v / jnp.clip(U_mag, config.U_mag_floor, None)
   301	    du_dt = accel * cos_a
   302	    dv_dt = accel * sin_a
   303	
   304	    # Frictional heating
   305	    dT_dt = -(u * du_dt + v * dv_dt) / constants.c_pd
   306	
   307	    # Column dissipation (positive-definite: KE lost by the mean flow)
   308	    eps_gwd = -jnp.sum(rho * (u * du_dt + v * dv_dt) * dz, axis=1)
   309	
   310	    return GWDOutput(du_dt=du_dt, dv_dt=dv_dt, dT_dt=dT_dt, eps_gwd=eps_gwd)
     1	"""Configuration for gravity wave drag schemes.

   521	    """Configuration for the E3SM/CAM frontal source (``gw_cm_src``).

   524

   528	        Background source strength [Pa] (default 1.5e-3, CAM ``taubgnd``).
   529	    frontgfc : float
   530	        Frontogenesis-function critical threshold [K^2/(m^2 s)] above which
   531	        the frontal source launches (default 1.25e-15 — the E3SM OPERATIONAL
   532	        namelist value, namelist_defaults_eam.xml:524; the coarse 4x5 grid
   533	        uses 7.5e-16).  The earlier default of 1.0e-10 sat ~5 ORDERS OF
   534	        MAGNITUDE above anything the resolved flow produces (10-day r16 AMIP
   535	        A/B 2026-07-20: max frontgf 5.4e-15, p99 2.4e-16), so the frontal
   536	        source could NEVER fire; 1.25e-15 sits at the observed
   537	        distribution's tail, selecting only the strongest resolved fronts —
   538	        exactly the CAM design intent.
   539	    c0 : float
   540	        Gaussian width in phase speed [m/s] (default 30.0, CAM ``c0``).
   541	    launch_p : float
   542	        Pressure [Pa] of the wave LAUNCH interface ``kbot`` (E3SM ``kbotbg``,
   543	        the interface nearest 500 hPa; default 5.0e4).
   544	    front_p : float
   545	        Pressure [Pa] of the frontogenesis TRIGGER level ``kfront`` (E3SM
   546	        ``kfront``, the level near 600 hPa where ``frontgf`` is tested;
   547	        default 6.0e4).  E3SM tests the trigger at ``kfront`` but launches at
   548	        ``kbot`` — these are NOT the same level.
   549	    front_spectrum_dc_resolution : float
   550	        Sub-bin c-grid spacing [m/s] for the Gaussian phase-speed
   551	        quadrature in ``gw_front_init`` (``dca``); each phase-speed bin
   552	        of width ``dc`` is integrated over ``nint(dc/dca)`` sub-intervals
   553	        (default 0.1, E3SM ``gw_front.F90`` ``dca``).
   554	    latitude_taper : bool
   555	        Apply the ``cos(lat)`` polar taper to the frontal tendencies.  E3SM
   556	        sets this BY DYCORE (gw_drag.F90:829-833: ``do_latitude_taper =
   557	        .not. dycore_is('UNSTRUCTURED')``): ``True`` on structured lat-lon
   558	        grids, ``False`` on the unstructured (SE-family) dycore — which
   559	        dycore a production campaign ran is not provable from the vendored
   560	        tree.  legoESM's
   561	        cubed-sphere / icosahedral / MPAS grids correspond to the
   562	        UNSTRUCTURED branch, so the E3SM-equivalent value there is
   563	        ``False`` — the default ``True`` (legacy, matches E3SM structured)
   564	        suppresses frontal drag toward the poles (→ 0), a first-order
   565	        high-latitude difference.  Flip per grid family; behavioral →
   566	        AMIP-gated.
   567	    """
   568	    taubgnd: float = 1.5e-3
   569	    frontgfc: float = 1.25e-15
   570	    c0: float = 30.0

  1255	    # pressure gradient an unweighted del2 redistributes a little water mass
  1256	    # (bias set by the humidity–terrain correlation), so this is an explicitly
  1257	    # NON-conservative grid-scale filter — monitor the water budget if used in
  1258	    # long runs.  Unweighted (not dp-weighted) is REQUIRED: the default hybrid
  1259	    # coordinate's surface-layer dp goes <= 0 for p_s below ~2/3 p_ref over
  1260	    # high terrain, which a dp-weighted form would divide by (Inf/NaN).  It is
  1261	    # a del2 (∇²), not the FV lanes' scale-selective del4 (∇⁴): del2 is
  1262	    # monotone under the explicit guard (hence the exact per-level integral)
  1263	    # but damps resolved gradients more broadly — use a gentle coefficient.

 succeeded in 737ms:
     1	"""``gwd_config_for`` — the third resolver (turbulence / convection / GWD).
     2	
     3	Every lane (FV pipeline, MPAS, spectral) previously built
     4	``GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme=...)`` from the scheme STRING alone, so the
     5	tuned ExperimentConfig scalars never reached the kernel on ANY production
     6	AMIP path (only the AIMIP training path consumed them).  This pins the
     7	overlay, the override precedence, and the composite-scheme behaviour.
     8	"""
     9	
    10	import pytest
    11	
    12	from legoesm.atmosphere.physics.gravity_wave_drag.config import (
    13	    GravityWaveDragConfig,
    14	)
    15	from legoesm.driver.config import (
    16	    DycoreConfig,
    17	    ExperimentConfig,
    18	    GridConfig,
    19	    OutputConfig,
    20	)
    21	from legoesm.driver.physics_pipeline import gwd_config_for
    22	
    23	
    24	def _cfg(**kw):
    25	    return ExperimentConfig(
    26	        grid=GridConfig(grid_type="mpas", resolution=1, nlev=8,
    27	                        vertical_coord="sigma"),
    28	        dycore=DycoreConfig(dt=600.0, discretization="mpas"),
    29	        output=OutputConfig(diag_days=1),
    30	        days=1, dataset="analytical", radiation="gray",
    31	        **kw,
    32	    )
    33	
    34	
    35	def test_defaults_match_bare_config():
    36	    """Untouched scalars reproduce the bare per-scheme defaults."""
    37	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(gravity_wave_drag="mcfarlane"))
    38	    bare = GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme="mcfarlane")
    39	    assert got.mcfarlane == bare.mcfarlane
    40	    assert got.hines == bare.hines
    41	
    42	
    43	def test_none_scheme_short_circuits():
    44	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(gravity_wave_drag="none"))
    45	    assert got.scheme == "none"
    46	    assert got == GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme="none")
    47	
    48	
    49	def test_mcfarlane_scalars_reach_the_leaf():
    50	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(
    51	        gravity_wave_drag="mcfarlane",
    52	        mcfarlane_tau_max=4.0,
    53	        mcfarlane_k_wave=1.0e-4,
    54	        mcfarlane_directional_spread=0.5,
    55	    ))
    56	    assert got.mcfarlane.tau_max == 4.0
    57	    assert got.mcfarlane.k_wave == 1.0e-4
    58	    assert got.mcfarlane.directional_spread == 0.5
    59	
    60	
    61	def test_hines_scalars_reach_the_leaf():
    62	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(
    63	        gravity_wave_drag="hines",
    64	        hines_total_rms_wind=1.2,
    65	        hines_Fmax=0.05,
    66	    ))
    67	    assert got.hines.total_rms_wind == 1.2
    68	    assert got.hines.Fmax == 0.05
    69	
    70	
    71	def test_composite_scheme_carries_both_tuned_leaves():
    72	    """'mcfarlane+hines' runs BOTH kernels — both overlays must apply."""
    73	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(
    74	        gravity_wave_drag="mcfarlane+hines",
    75	        mcfarlane_tau_max=6.0,
    76	        hines_total_rms_wind=1.5,
    77	    ))
    78	    assert got.scheme == "mcfarlane+hines"
    79	    assert got.mcfarlane.tau_max == 6.0
    80	    assert got.hines.total_rms_wind == 1.5
    81	
    82	
    83	def test_explicit_override_wins_verbatim():
    84	    """An injected full config is never second-guessed by the overlay."""
    85	    inj = GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme="mcfarlane")
    86	    inj = inj._replace(mcfarlane=inj.mcfarlane._replace(tau_max=99.0))
    87	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(
    88	        gravity_wave_drag="mcfarlane",
    89	        gravity_wave_drag_override=inj,
    90	        mcfarlane_tau_max=4.0,   # must NOT win over the override
    91	    ))
    92	    assert got is inj
    93	    assert got.mcfarlane.tau_max == 99.0
    94	
    95	
    96	def test_other_leaves_untouched():
    97	    """Overlaying mcfarlane/hines leaves the other scheme leaves at defaults."""
    98	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(gravity_wave_drag="mcfarlane",
    99	                              mcfarlane_tau_max=4.0))
   100	    bare = GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme="mcfarlane")
   101	    assert got.rayleigh == bare.rayleigh
   102	    assert got.lindzen == bare.lindzen
   103	    assert got.e3sm_cam == bare.e3sm_cam
   104	    assert got.prognostic_spectral == bare.prognostic_spectral
   105	
   106	
   107	def test_resolve_gwd_uses_the_resolver():
   108	    """The FV pipeline path honours the same tuned leaf (no divergence)."""

     1	"""Zarr-based checkpoint IO for legoESM.
     2	
     3	Provides save/load of atmospheric state to/from Zarr stores with Zstd
     4	compression. Backward-compatible with existing .npz checkpoints
     5	via auto-detection in ``load_checkpoint_auto``.
     6	
     7	Compatible with zarr v2 (>= 2.18) and v3 (>= 3.0).
     8	"""
     9	from __future__ import annotations
    10	
    11	import json
    12	from pathlib import Path
    13	
    14	import jax
    15	import numpy as np
    16	
    17	
    18	def wallclock_exhausted(elapsed_s: float, max_s: float, buffer_s: float) -> bool:
    19	    """True if the run should checkpoint and exit to fit the wallclock budget.
    20	
    21	    ``max_s <= 0`` disables the check.  Otherwise fire once the elapsed time is
    22	    within ``buffer_s`` of the budget, leaving time to write the checkpoint
    23	    before the scheduler kills the job (so a dependency chain can resume).
    24	    Shared by the OMIP/LMIP run drivers (previously copy-pasted).
    25	    """
    26	    return max_s > 0.0 and elapsed_s >= (max_s - buffer_s)
    27	
    28	
    29	# Lazy imports to avoid circular dependency:
    30	#   io.checkpoint → driver.config → driver.__init__ → model_driver → io.checkpoint
    31	_experiment_config_from_dict = None
    32	
    33	
    34	def _get_experiment_config_from_dict():
    35	    global _experiment_config_from_dict
    36	    if _experiment_config_from_dict is None:
    37	        from legoesm.driver.config import experiment_config_from_dict
    38	        _experiment_config_from_dict = experiment_config_from_dict
    39	    return _experiment_config_from_dict
    40	
    41	
    42	def _config_from_dict_auto(d: dict):
    43	    """Detect config format and deserialize.
    44	
    45	    ExperimentConfig JSON has a ``"grid"`` key with nested sub-configs;
    46	    legacy AMIPExperimentConfig JSON has flat fields (``"resolution"``
    47	    at the top level).
    48	
    49	    Returns an ``ExperimentConfig`` in both cases (upconverting legacy
    50	    AMIP format via ``ExperimentConfig.from_amip_config``).
    51	    """
    52	    if "grid" in d and isinstance(d["grid"], dict):
    53	        # New ExperimentConfig format
    54	        ecfd = _get_experiment_config_from_dict()
    55	        return ecfd(d)
    56	    else:
    57	        # Legacy AMIPExperimentConfig format — load then upconvert.
    58	        # Deferred driver.config import: a top-level one would reintroduce the
    59	        # io.checkpoint -> driver.config -> driver.__init__ -> model_driver cycle.
    60	        from legoesm.driver.config import config_from_dict
    61	        amip_cfg = config_from_dict(d)
    62	        from legoesm.driver.config import ExperimentConfig
    63	        return ExperimentConfig.from_amip_config(amip_cfg)
    64	
    65	
    66	def _auto_chunks(shape: tuple[int, ...]) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    67	    """Choose chunk shape: per-face for 4D (6,n,n,nlev), whole-array otherwise."""
    68	    if len(shape) == 4 and shape[0] == 6:
    69	        # One chunk per face: (1, n, n, nlev)
    70	        return (1,) + shape[1:]
    71	    return shape
    72	
    73	
    74	def save_checkpoint_zarr(
    75	    path,
    76	    state,
    77	    q_v,
    78	    step: int,
    79	    day: float,
    80	    config,
    81	    *,
    82	    q_c=None,
    83	    q_r=None,
    84	    diag_accumulators: dict | None = None,
    85	    compressor=None,
    86	) -> None:
    87	    """Save checkpoint to Zarr store.
    88	
    89	    Layout::
    90	
   255	        u=Field(data=u, name="u", dims=dims_3d, units="m/s"),
   256	        v=Field(data=v, name="v", dims=dims_3d, units="m/s"),
   257	        T=Field(data=T, name="T", dims=dims_3d, units="K"),
   258	        p_s=Field(data=p_s, name="p_s", dims=dims_2d, units="Pa"),
   259	        phis=Field(data=phis, name="phis", dims=dims_2d, units="m^2/s^2"),
   260	    )
   261	
   262	    config_str = root.attrs.get("config_json", "{}")
   263	    config = _config_from_dict_auto(json.loads(config_str))
   264	
   265	    diag_accumulators = {}
   266	    for k in array_names:
   267	        if k.startswith("diag_"):
   268	            arr = root[k]
   269	            diag_accumulators[k[5:]] = arr[()] if arr.ndim == 0 else arr[:]
   270	
   271	    q_c = jnp.array(root["q_c"][:], dtype=_storage_dtype) if "q_c" in root else None
   272	    q_r = jnp.array(root["q_r"][:], dtype=_storage_dtype) if "q_r" in root else None
   273	
   274	    return state, q_v, step, day, config, diag_accumulators, q_c, q_r
   275	
   276	
   277	def _upconvert_config(config):
   278	    """Ensure *config* is an ExperimentConfig.
   279	
   280	    If it is already an ExperimentConfig, return as-is.
   281	    If it is an AMIPExperimentConfig, upconvert via
   282	    ``ExperimentConfig.from_amip_config``.
   283	    """
   284	    from legoesm.driver.config import ExperimentConfig
   285	    if isinstance(config, ExperimentConfig):
   286	        return config
   287	    return ExperimentConfig.from_amip_config(config)
   288	
   289	
   290	def load_checkpoint_auto(path, grid, sigma):
   291	    """Auto-detect checkpoint format (.npz or .zarr) and load.
   292	
   293	    Returns an ``ExperimentConfig`` regardless of whether the
   294	    checkpoint was saved with the legacy AMIP format or the new
   295	    ExperimentConfig format.
   296	
   297	    Parameters
   298	    ----------
   299	    path : Path-like
   300	    grid : grid object
   301	    sigma : vertical coordinate
   302	
   303	    Returns
   304	    -------
   305	    tuple
   306	        9-tuple: (state, q_v, step, day, config, diag_accumulators,
   307	        q_c, q_r, carry_aux).  *config* is always an
   308	        ``ExperimentConfig``.
   309	    """
   310	    from legoesm.forcing.amip_config import load_checkpoint as load_npz

   206	class RayleighConfig(NamedTuple):
   207	    """Configuration for Rayleigh friction drag.
   208	
   209	    Fields
   210	    ------
   211	    k_max : float
   212	        Maximum drag coefficient [1/s] (default 1/(1*86400)).
   213	    sigma_b : float
   214	        Boundary layer top sigma level (default 0.7).
   215	    sponge_top : float
   216	        Upper sponge sigma level (default 0.02).
   217	    sponge_k : float
   218	        Upper sponge drag coefficient [1/s] (default 1/(0.5*86400)).
   219	    """
   220	    k_max: float = 1.0 / 86400.0
   221	    sigma_b: float = 0.7
   222	    sponge_top: float = 0.02
   223	    sponge_k: float = 1.0 / (0.5 * 86400.0)
   224

   226	class LindzenConfig(NamedTuple):
   227	    """Configuration for smoothed Lindzen (1981) orographic GWD.
   228	
   229	    Fields
   230	    ------
   231	    h_topo : float
   232	        Sub-grid topographic height [m] (default 500).
   233	    k_wave : float
   234	        Horizontal wavenumber [1/m] (default 2*pi/100e3).
   235	    fcrit2 : float
   236	        Critical Froude number squared scaling the saturation CAP VALUE
   237	        (``tau_sat_eff = fcrit2*tau_sat`` — the oracle ``effkwv = kwv*fcrit2``
   238	        semantics, E3SM gw_common.F90:153; Lindzen's limit scales with
   239	        ``Fr_c²``). The breaking sigmoid activates at the fixed threshold
   240	        ``tau_carry > tau_sat_eff`` and relaxes toward ``tau_sat_eff``; the
   241	        saturation is SOFT (finite-sharpness sigmoid), NOT an exact hard cap.
   242	        Default 1.0 (``Fr_c = 1``) caps at the exact Lindzen ``tau_sat``.
   243	        Formerly named ``critical_Fr`` and wired only as the sigmoid
   244	        ACTIVATION center with an unscaled relaxation target, which left the
   245	        knob inert wherever ``tau_carry <= tau_sat``.
   246	    Fr_sharpness : float
   247	        Sigmoid sharpness for the saturation stress-ratio breaking transition

    35	def test_defaults_match_bare_config():

    37	    got = gwd_config_for(_cfg(gravity_wave_drag="mcfarlane"))
    38	    bare = GravityWaveDragConfig(scheme="mcfarlane")
    39	    assert got.mcfarlane == bare.mcfarlane
    40	    assert got.hines == bare.hines

    43	def test_none_scheme_short_circuits():

    45	    assert got.scheme == "none"

   142	    ExperimentConfig scalar changes the resolved scheme config the pipeline
   143	    builds.  This is the guard against the name-convention hazard — many
   144	    ``<prefix>_<field>`` scalars EXIST but are never read (codex #691), so the
   145	    map is a verified allowlist, not a convention.  Also fails if a NEW scalar
   146	    becomes threaded but is missing from the map (extend it)."""

   167	        # warm-rain hard-saturation-adjustment overrides: activate each scheme
   168	        # so _resolve_microphysics threads the flat scalar into its sub-config.
   169	        "KesslerConfig": {"microphysics": "kessler"},

   172	        "SeifertBehengConfig": {"microphysics": "seifert_beheng"},
   173	        "ThompsonConfig": {"microphysics": "thompson"},

   182	        "SeifertBehengConfig": "micro_config",

   286	def apply_params_to_config(config, params: dict, *, driver: str = "run",
   287	                           scalar_param_map: dict | None = None):
   288	    """Return ``config`` with calibration ``params`` (qualified_name: value)
   289	    spliced into the matching nested ``*Config`` NamedTuples.
   290	
   291	    ``scalar_param_map`` (``{qualified_name: config_field}``) handles configs
   292	    that FLATTEN their tunable scheme params to top-level scalar fields instead
   293	    of nesting the ``*Config`` — the atmosphere ExperimentConfig (see
   294	    :func:`build_atm_scalar_param_map`).  A mapped parameter is applied to the
   295	    top ``config`` via ``_replace`` (validated + bounds-checked identically);
   296	    unmapped parameters use the nested class-router below.
   297	
   298	    Each key is validated against ``param_collector.build_registry`` (must be a
   299	    known parameter and, for scalar params, within its ``__param_spec__``
   300	    bounds) and routed to the config of its declared ``(module, config_class)``.
   301	    Raises ``SystemExit`` on an unknown parameter, a non-numeric or out-of-bounds
   302	    value, or a target config that is absent from / ambiguous in this run's
   303	    config tree — a ``--params`` file can never silently mis-set physics.  A
   304	    no-op for empty ``params``.
   305	
   306	    Note (soft limitation): a union config that holds ALL of a family's scheme
   307	    sub-configs simultaneously (``VerticalMixingConfig`` carries kpp/tke/catke;
   308	    ``MultiLayerLandConfig`` carries carbon + stomata) is always "present", so an
   309	    override for a scheme that is not the *selected* one is applied to that
   310	    (inert) sub-config rather than raising — it simply has no effect on the run.
   311	    The strict absent-raise still catches wrong-component params (e.g. an
   312	    atmosphere param in an ocean-only run).
   313	    """
   314	    if not params:
   315	        return config
   316	    from legoesm.training.param_collector import build_registry
   317	    registry = {m.qualified_name: m for m in build_registry()}
   318	    scalar_param_map = scalar_param_map or {}
   319	    by_key: dict[tuple, dict[str, float]] = {}
   320	    key_to_qname: dict[tuple, str] = {}
   321	    flat: dict[str, float] = {}
   322	    for qname, value in params.items():
   323	        meta = registry.get(qname)
   324	        if meta is None:
   325	            raise SystemExit(
   326	                f"{driver} --params: unknown parameter {qname!r} (not in the "
   327	                "parameter registry).  Keys must be a param_collector qualified "
   328	                "name 'scheme_key.field' (see config/cmip/params_tuned.yaml)."
   329	            )
   330	        # Scalar params (shape_key None) are numeric — coerce (YAML may quote
   331	        # the value) and range-check against __param_spec__ bounds.  Array params
   332	        # keep their list value (per-element tuple bounds are not range-checked).
   333	        if meta.shape_key is None:
   334	            try:
   335	                value = float(value)
   336	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
   337	                raise SystemExit(
   338	                    f"{driver} --params: {qname} value {value!r} is not numeric."
   339	                )
   340	            lo, hi = meta.bounds
   341	            if isinstance(lo, (int, float)) and isinstance(hi, (int, float)):
   342	                if not (lo <= value <= hi):
   343	                    raise SystemExit(
   344	                        f"{driver} --params: {qname}={value} is outside its "
   345	                        f"__param_spec__ bounds [{lo}, {hi}]."
   346	                    )
   347	        ec_field = scalar_param_map.get(qname)
   348	        if ec_field is not None:
   349	            flat[ec_field] = value  # flattened scalar on the top config
   350	        else:
   351	            key = (meta.module, meta.config_class)
   352	            by_key.setdefault(key, {})[meta.field] = value
   353	            key_to_qname[key] = qname
   354	    if flat:
   355	        top_fields = getattr(config, "_fields", ())
   356	        bad = [f for f in flat if f not in top_fields]
   357	        if bad:
   358	            raise SystemExit(
   359	                f"{driver} --params: mapped scalar field(s) {bad} are not on "
   360	                f"{type(config).__name__} — the atmosphere scalar-param map does "
   361	                "not match this driver's config."
   362	            )
   363	        config = config._replace(**flat)
   364	    applied: set = set()
   365	    config = _route_overrides_by_class(config, by_key, applied=applied)
   366	    missing = set(by_key) - applied
   367	    if missing:
   368	        examples = ", ".join(sorted(key_to_qname[k] for k in missing))
   369	        raise SystemExit(
   370	            f"{driver} --params: parameter(s) {examples} target config "
   371	            f"class(es) {sorted(k[1] for k in missing)} that are not present in "
   372	            "this run's config (the scheme is not built into this driver's "
   373	            "config object).  Remove them or enable the scheme."
   374	        )
   375	    return config

   107	def _compute_uncovered() -> set[str]:
   108	    """Uncovered tunables, honoring run_coupled's clobber-refusal contract.
   109	
   110	    ``run_coupled._check_params_clobber`` hard-refuses routes whose overrides
   111	    ``CoupledESMDriver.setup()`` would rebuild-and-discard, so the coupled
   112	    bundle must NOT count as coverage for them:
   113	
   114	    * ``ocean.*`` — refused unconditionally (calibrate via run_omip);
   115	    * ``land.carbon.*`` — refused unconditionally (calibrate via run_lmip);
   116	    * other ``land.*`` — refused under the DEFAULT ``--land-params clm`` but
   117	      settable with ``--land-params analytical``, so the coupled route still
   118	      counts (conditional reachability, documented in the guard's error).
   119	    """
   120	    omip_keys, lmip_keys, coupled_keys = _driver_key_sets()
   121	    amap = set(build_atm_scalar_param_map())
   122	    uncovered: set[str] = set()
   123	    for m in build_registry():
   124	        if m.tunable_tier not in _TUNABLE_TIERS:
   125	            continue
   126	        key = (m.module, m.config_class)
   127	        comp = m.qualified_name.split(".")[0]
   128	        if comp == "atm":
   129	            covered = m.qualified_name in amap
   130	        elif comp == "ocean":
   131	            # run_coupled refuses ALL ocean.* (--params clobber guard), so
   132	            # only run_omip counts.
   133	            covered = key in omip_keys
   134	        elif comp == "land":
   135	            # run_coupled refuses land.carbon.* unconditionally; non-carbon
   136	            # land.* is reachable there only via --land-params analytical.
   137	            coupled_ok = (key in coupled_keys
   138	                          and not m.qualified_name.startswith("land.carbon."))
   139	            covered = key in lmip_keys or coupled_ok
   140	        else:  # ice, coupler
   141	            covered = key in coupled_keys
   142	        if not covered:
   143	            uncovered.add(m.qualified_name)
   144	    return uncovered
   145

   184	def test_clobber_refused_routes_have_covering_alternative():
   185	    """Mechanical form of ``run_coupled._check_params_clobber``'s contract
   186	    prose: every route the guard REFUSES must leave the parameter settable in
   187	    the alternative driver its error message points at — otherwise the refusal
   188	    would orphan a tunable and the guard-faithful branches in
   189	    ``_compute_uncovered`` would silently hide it:
   190	
   191	    * ``ocean.*`` refused -> run_omip must cover every ocean param the coupled
   192	      bundle could otherwise route ("0 ocean params are coupled-only");
   193	    * ``land.carbon.*`` refused -> run_lmip must route ``CarbonConfig``.
   194	
   195	    (The stronger form — assert ``CoupledESMDriver.setup()`` literally rebuilds
   196	    each refused config — needs a full setup() run with mesh build + CLM
   197	    surfdata download, not unit-test-cheap; the guard refusals themselves are
   198	    pinned by test_run_coupled_config_yaml.py::test_params_clobber_guard.)"""
   199	    omip_keys, lmip_keys, coupled_keys = _driver_key_sets()
   200	    for m in build_registry():
   201	        if m.tunable_tier not in _TUNABLE_TIERS:
   202	            continue
   203	        key = (m.module, m.config_class)
   204	        if m.qualified_name.startswith("ocean.") and key in coupled_keys:
   205	            assert key in omip_keys, (
   206	                f"{m.qualified_name}: run_coupled refuses ocean.* --params and "
   207	                "points at run_omip, which does not route this config — the "
   208	                "refusal orphans an otherwise coupled-routable ocean tunable."
   209	            )
   210	        if m.qualified_name.startswith("land.carbon."):
   211	            assert key in lmip_keys, (
   212	                f"{m.qualified_name}: run_coupled refuses land.carbon.* and "
   213	                "points at run_lmip, which does not route CarbonConfig."
   214	            )

  2701	    itself a nested ``EvaluationConfig`` NamedTuple one level deeper —
  2702	    without this it round-trips through ``json.dumps`` as a bare

  2708	    # the base config, and the override is re-applied in memory after load (the
  2709	    # correction loop's build_driver). Drop it so it cannot be stringified +
  2710	    # silently corrupted on round-trip.

   120	    "sign_convention": (
   121	        "z up. Drag opposes the wind: accel is a pure deceleration along the "
   122	        "local wind vector (du_dt*u + dv_dt*v <= 0); stress decrement "
   123	        "drag = rho*(sigma_grown^2 - sigma_new^2) is floored at 0 (a sink). "
   124	        "eps_gwd>=0 is the column KE loss returned as frictional heating "
   125	        "dT_dt = -(u*du_dt + v*dv_dt)/c_pd."
   126	    ),
   127	    # KE->heat is an EXACT local closure: the resolved mean-flow KE removed
   128	    # (-U.a) is returned exactly as frictional heating (c_pd*sum(rho*dT_dt*dz)
   129	    # == eps_gwd). But total WAVE + mean-flow ENERGY is NOT conserved: the
   130	    # launched wave is an EXTERNAL/unbudgeted source, and the Fmax cap + the
   131	    # tendency limiter discard the implied carry loss (the scan removes the
   132	    # full uncapped amplitude loss from the wave but deposits only the capped
   133	    # stress on the mean flow). Momentum is not conserved either. Hence
   134	    # "none" -- the only exact invariant is the resolved-KE->heat closure,

   153	    u: jax.Array,
   154	    v: jax.Array,
   155	    T: jax.Array,
   156	    p_full: jax.Array,
   157	    p_half: jax.Array,
   158	    z_full: jax.Array,
   159	    z_half: jax.Array,
   160	    rho: jax.Array,
   161	    lat: jax.Array,
   162	    dt: float,
   163	    config: HinesConfig,
   164	) -> GWDOutput:
   165	    """Compute Hines-inspired bulk GWD tendencies.
   166	
   167	    Parameters
   168	    ----------
   169	    u, v, T, p_full, p_half, z_full, z_half, rho, lat, dt, config
   170	        Standard GWD backend signature. All column arrays (ncol, nlev).
   171	
   172	    Returns

   174	    GWDOutput

   180	
   181	    # Wind magnitude at each level
   182	    U_mag = jnp.sqrt(u ** 2 + v ** 2 + 1e-10)

   185	    dz = jnp.abs(z_half[:, :-1] - z_half[:, 1:])

   187

   189	    # As the bulk wave propagates upward its amplitude grows with decreasing
   190	    # density (the code's assumed WKB invariant rho*sigma^2 = const; this is
   191	    # NOT the true momentum flux rho*<u'w'>).  Saturation occurs when the
   192	    # wave-induced velocity perturbation reaches a BULK saturation-amplitude
   193	    # scale ``sigma_sat = N / m_*`` (a velocity ~ the intrinsic phase speed;
   194	    # a heuristic, NOT Hines 1997 eq. 9's cutoff wavenumber), constant per
   195	    # column at fixed N and m_*.  An earlier formulation divided this
   196	    # by ``rho_ratio = sqrt(rho_sfc/rho) ≥ 1`` ⇒ ``sigma_sat`` *decreased*
   197	    # with altitude, the opposite of physical expectation: amplitudes
   198	    # grow with altitude (1/sqrt(rho)) so the cap should remain at least
   199	    # constant.  The /rho_ratio factor caused premature saturation aloft

   205	    # ``sqrt(rho[k+1] / rho[k])`` (energy conservation rho * sigma^2).
   206	    # The carry already contains the integrated WKB amplitude from the
   207	    # surface to level k+1, so we multiply by the *inter-level* ratio,
   208	    # not the cumulative ``sqrt(rho_sfc/rho_k)``.  Multiplying by the
   209	    # cumulative factor at every step compounds the growth and
   210	    # over-amplifies the wave by a product of cumulative ratios — a

   214	    rho_ratio_step = rho_ratio_step.at[:, :-1].set(

   216	            rho[:, 1:] / jnp.clip(rho[:, :-1], 0.01, None), 1.0, None,  # coeff-ok: density-ratio floor
   217	        ))
   218	    )
   219

   221	    # ``rho_ratio_step[:, k]`` carries amplitude from level k+1 to level k;
   222	    # at the surface (k = nlev-1) the step factor is 1 (initial condition).
   223	    def scan_fn(carry, k_rev):
   224	        sigma_gw = carry
   225	        k = nlev - 1 - k_rev
   226	
   227	        # Amplitude growth from density decrease (single-layer step)
   228	        sigma_grown = sigma_gw * rho_ratio_step[:, k]
   229	
   230	        # Smooth blend toward the saturation amplitude. ABOVE threshold
   231	        # (sigma_grown > sigma_sat) this dissipates (sigma_new < sigma_grown,

   236	        # negative decrement, so this sub-threshold amplitude gain is neither

   243

   245	        # code's ASSUMED fixed wave geometry/proportionality ``F ∝ ρσ²`` this
   246	        # reads as a stress-flux divergence between two levels of the WKB-grown
   247	        # wave; it is NOT the physical spectral flux ``F = ρ·<u'w'>`` — Hines'

   269	        # Python-float ``config.*`` constants promote ``sigma_new`` to f64, but
   270	        # the scan carry init (sigma_gw_init) is ``u.dtype`` (f32) — lax.scan
   271	        # requires carry in/out dtypes to match, so cast the carry output.
   272	        return sigma_new.astype(sigma_gw.dtype), drag

   274	    # Pin the carry dtype so the scan body stays at the input precision
   275	    # (defaulting allows x64 to silently promote the launch wind to f64).
   276	    sigma_gw_init = jnp.full((ncol,), config.total_rms_wind, dtype=u.dtype)
   277	    _, drag_stack = jax.lax.scan(scan_fn, sigma_gw_init, jnp.arange(nlev))
   278	    drag_all = drag_stack.T[:, ::-1]  # (ncol, nlev), top-first

   281	    accel = -drag_all / jnp.clip(rho * dz, 1e-10, None)

   107	def _compute_uncovered() -> set[str]:
   108	    """Uncovered tunables, honoring run_coupled's clobber-refusal contract.
   109	
   110	    ``run_coupled._check_params_clobber`` hard-refuses routes whose overrides
   111	    ``CoupledESMDriver.setup()`` would rebuild-and-discard, so the coupled
   112	    bundle must NOT count as coverage for them:
   113	
   114	    * ``ocean.*`` — refused unconditionally (calibrate via run_omip);
   115	    * ``land.carbon.*`` — refused unconditionally (calibrate via run_lmip);
   116	    * other ``land.*`` — refused under the DEFAULT ``--land-params clm`` but
   117	      settable with ``--land-params analytical``, so the coupled route still
   118	      counts (conditional reachability, documented in the guard's error).
   119	    """
   120	    omip_keys, lmip_keys, coupled_keys = _driver_key_sets()
   121	    amap = set(build_atm_scalar_param_map())
   122	    uncovered: set[str] = set()
   123	    for m in build_registry():
   124	        if m.tunable_tier not in _TUNABLE_TIERS:
   125	            continue
   126	        key = (m.module, m.config_class)
   127	        comp = m.qualified_name.split(".")[0]
   128	        if comp == "atm":
   129	            covered = m.qualified_name in amap
   130	        elif comp == "ocean":
   131	            # run_coupled refuses ALL ocean.* (--params clobber guard), so
   132	            # only run_omip counts.
   133	            covered = key in omip_keys
   134	        elif comp == "land":
   135	            # run_coupled refuses land.carbon.* unconditionally; non-carbon
   136	            # land.* is reachable there only via --land-params analytical.
   137	            coupled_ok = (key in coupled_keys
   138	                          and not m.qualified_name.startswith("land.carbon."))
   139	            covered = key in lmip_keys or coupled_ok
   140	        else:  # ice, coupler
   141	            covered = key in coupled_keys
   142	        if not covered:
   143	            uncovered.add(m.qualified_name)
   144	    return uncovered

   186	    prose: every route the guard REFUSES must leave the parameter settable in
   187	    the alternative driver its error message points at — otherwise the refusal
   188	    would orphan a tunable and the guard-faithful branches in
   189	    ``_compute_uncovered`` would silently hide it:
   190	
   191	    * ``ocean.*`` refused -> run_omip must cover every ocean param the coupled
   192	      bundle could otherwise route ("0 ocean params are coupled-only");
   193	    * ``land.carbon.*`` refused -> run_lmip must route ``CarbonConfig``.
   194

   196	    each refused config — needs a full setup() run with mesh build + CLM
   197	    surfdata download, not unit-test-cheap; the guard refusals themselves are
   198	    pinned by test_run_coupled_config_yaml.py::test_params_clobber_guard.)"""
   199	    omip_keys, lmip_keys, coupled_keys = _driver_key_sets()
   200	    for m in build_registry():

   202	            continue
   203	        key = (m.module, m.config_class)
   204	        if m.qualified_name.startswith("ocean.") and key in coupled_keys:

   207	                "points at run_omip, which does not route this config — the "
   208	                "refusal orphans an otherwise coupled-routable ocean tunable."
   209	            )
